520	Again: so that after 120 years of Rav Shach there will be someone fit to instruct others to go out
521	and work, so that is why I stay.
522	Because if I go out to work, I will not be a Torah scholar.
523	And if I am not a Torah scholar, I will not be able to instruct people to go out and work.
524	So that is why he stayed.
525	So, on Purim, a few students from the yeshiva came to Rav Shach.
526	They sat with him, Torah thoughts, and there was joy.
527	Suddenly Rav Shlomo Lorincz walked in.
528	Do you remember him?
529	He was a Knesset member, he was also a deputy minister, he had...
530	What?
531	Chairman of the Finance Committee.
532	Chairman of the Finance Committee.
533	He came in, and the students immediately understood: Rav Lorincz came in, a Knesset member, so they have to
534	make room for him, in any case, a distinguished person, he came in.
535	So they got up and went to make room for him to enter. He came with a mishloach manot.
536	Rav Shach signaled to them: sit.
537	He took Rav Lorincz to the kitchen.
538	He gave him a different mishloach manot, accompanied him outside, did everything properly.
539	He came back and told them how important he is, how much he brings merit to the many, and how much depends on him.
540	But yeshiva students who sit and learn, their level is greater, their
541	standing is more important.
542	And he stayed to talk with these young students, to show them that they are more important than that Knesset
543	member.
544	And therefore, the Gemara says in tractate Megillah, page 16b:
545	Torah study is greater than saving lives. What does it mean that Torah study is greater than
546	saving lives?
547	The Atei Zahav says, Yoreh Deah, siman 251, small paragraph 6, laws of tzedakah:
548	Imagine now a suicide terrorist, may HaShem have mercy, who wants to enter
549	the mall there, Malha Mall.
550	He wants to enter the mall and carry out an attack, and the security guard discovers him, immediately jumps
551	on him, takes him down to the floor, ties his hands. Let's make it a story, yes.
552	Okay, and he saved all the people in Malha Mall. They will let him light
553	a torch on Independence Day and he will receive a citizen's, I don't know how you say it, a medal
554	of honor. But a yeshiva student, or a person who sits here and learns
555	in the synagogue, in the street, at that same time, says the Atei Zahav, in heaven he receives a reward much
556	higher than that security guard who saved hundreds of people. You
557	have that, how do you say it, the plumber,
558	that plumber, yes, from the plane, I don't remember his name,
559	that plumber who saved the 170 passengers there on the plane.
